stem: Which of these best summarizes the Monroe Doctrine?

options.label: F
options.text: The immigration of Europeans to the United States must be discouraged.

options.label: G
options.text: International peace can be maintained without complicated alliances.

options.label: H
options.text: The power to nullify federal laws is necessary to preserve sovereignty.

options.label: J
options.text: Further colonization of the Americas by European countries is prohibited.
